lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Good evening. How many?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: A table for two, please. We have a reservation under Lena Ortiz for seven.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Yes, I have it here. Right this way.

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: Would you like still or sparkling water?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Still water, please. Could we have two glasses?

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: Of course. Are you ready to order?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I think so. I'd like the tomato soup to start and the grilled chicken as my main.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Does the chicken come with a side?

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: Yes. It comes with potatoes or a green salad.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Great. I'd like the chicken with the salad, please. Could I have the dressing on the side?

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: Certainly. I'm sorry, but we've just sold the last bowl of tomato soup.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Oh. What other starters do you have?

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: We have a small plate of roasted vegetables and some garlic bread.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Then I'll have the roasted vegetables. That's all for now.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The food looks great. Could we have some more water when you have a moment?

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: Sure. Is everything else okay?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Yes, thank you. The vegetables were a good choice.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: And this salad is bigger than I expected.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Do you want help with it?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Actually, could you do me a favor and take one of these potatoes? I could really use your help.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: That's a serious request, but I accept.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I really appreciate it.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Happy to help.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: When we're ready, could we get the check, please?

lines.speaker: Server
lines.text: Of course. I'll bring it over.
